notes: Planning rules for the cash engine. Yields are never stored here: the T-bill and 10-year inputs come from market data, and CD / I-bond rates are entered by the user because they change on offer dates.

treasury_state_exempt.note: Interest on Treasury bills, notes, bonds and I-bonds is federally taxable and exempt from state and local income tax (31 U.S.C. 3124).

money_market_note: A government money-market fund passes state-exempt interest through only for the share held in direct Treasury obligations (many states also require a minimum share). The default of 0 is conservative; enter your fund's share from its annual state-tax-information notice.

ladder.curve_note: Between the 3-month T-bill and the 10-year yield the curve is linearly interpolated by maturity. This is a planning approximation; enter real auction yields to override.

cd.note: Typical penalty for CDs of one year or less; actual terms vary by bank.

reserve.note: Cash covering the first N retirement years of net withdrawals so a bad early market never forces stock sales (sequence-of-returns buffer).
